title.narrative: Youth NEETs in Southern Neighbourhood Countries

description.narrative: The project will operate as a Technical Assistance Facility (TAF) supporting, on a demand-driven basis, the institutions / stakeholders in the MENA region that are willing to develop innovative options in order to reengage NEET youth in education, training and the labour market. In the medium run, the TAF can be instrumental in establishing or even piloting some Young Guarantees Schemes (YGS) inspired by those existing in the EU.
